text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of an on-street accessible parking space on the east side of Robinson Avenues for persons with disabilities.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Designated an on-street accessible parking space on the east side of Robinson Avenue, between a point 36 metres south of Newport Avenue to a point 5.5 metres further south.
